title: Tanmaya Mohanty vs Madhumita James on 8 April, 2026

paragraphs.text:
IN THE HIGH COURT OF ORISSA AT CUTTACK

 MATA No.52 of 2026
 Tanmaya Mohanty .... Appellant

 Represented by Adv.-
 Mr. Gajendra Nath Rout,
 Advocate

 -versus-

 Madhumita James .... Respondent

 Represented by Adv.
 Ms. Pratyusha Naidu, Advocate

 CORAM:
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE MANASH RANJAN PATHAK
 AND
 HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE SIBO SANKAR MISHRA
 ORDER

Order No. 08.04.2026
 (Hybrid mode)
 I.A. No.84 of 2026
 03. 1. The appellant as petitioner has preferred Civil

Proceeding No.423 of 2019 under Section 10 of the
 Divorce Act, 1869 against the respondent-wife before
 the Court of the learned Judge, Family Court, Cuttack.
 By the impugned judgment dated 30.10.2025, the
 learned Judge, Family Court, Cuttack allowed the said
 Civil Proceeding and dissolved the marriage between
 the parties solemnized on 02.01.2008 directing the
 appellant to pay an amount of Rs.10,00,000/-
 (Rupees ten lakhs) to the respondent-wife as
 permanent alimony.

2. Aggrieved by the said judgment dated 30.10.2025,
the appellant has preferred the connected appeal with
a reported delay of 45 days.

3. It is to be noted herein that the respondent-wife as
appellant has also filed an appeal being MATA No.445
of 2025 in the impugned judgment dated 30.10.2025
as noted above, which is duly admitted.

4. We have heard learned counsels for both the
appellant as well as the respondent.

5. Ms. Pratyusha Naidu, learned counsel appearing
for the respondent-wife has no objection in condoning
the delay of 45 days in preferring the appeal by the
appellant-husband, subject to payment of cost.

6. Accordingly, the delay of 45 days is condoned,
subject to payment of cost of Rs.5,000/- (Rupees five
thousand) to be paid by the appellant-husband to the
respondent-wife by way of Demand Draft or in her
Account.

(Manash Ranjan Pathak)
 Judge



 (Sibo Sankar Mishra)
 Judge

 Page 2 of 3
 04. MATA No.52 of 2026

1. Heard Mr. Gajendra Nath Rout, learned counsel for
 the appellant-husband and Ms. Pratyusha Naidu,
 learned counsel for the respondent-wife.

3. The appellant shall serve a copy of the memo of
 appeal on Ms. Pratyusha Naidu, learned counsel for
 the respondent-wife, if not already served.

4. Learned counsel for the appellant as well as the
 respondent may obtain the soft copies of the records
 from the Registry.

5. List this matter after the ensuing summer vacation
 along with MATA No.445 of 2025.

(Manash Ranjan Pathak)
 Judge



 (Sibo Sankar Mishra)
 Judge
